# kbeaconlib2 (vendored)

KKM's iOS SDK for KBeacon Pro firmware, which Blue Charm beacons (the recommended BC-U1) run.
Copied unmodified from https://github.com/kkmhogen/kbeaconlib2 at 941a39e (v1.2.1), MIT license (see LICENSE).
Built as the `kbeaconlib2` framework target in project.yml so `import kbeaconlib2` matches upstream.
Used only by `App/BlueCharm.swift`, to set up and tune the beacon without the vendor's app.
